Anant Singh Big Statement :bihar ki siyasat men anant sinh ek bar phir charcha men hain. vidhanasbha ki sadasyata samapti ko lekar mile notis par anant sinh ne apni pratikriya di hai. unhonne kaha ki bete ki shadi ke bad vah vidhanasbha ko javab denge. anant sinh ne saph kaha ki pahle apna kam karenge, phir javab denge. aakhir sadasyata samapti ke notis par anant sinh ka kya rukh hai aur shadi ke bad unka agla kadam kya hoga? dekhie is riport men puri kahani.
